meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin during Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a **cream rather than a gel**, ideally with **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, and preferably fragrance-free. These help both hydrate and reduce moisture loss from the skin barrier. [zeelabpharmacy.com](https://zeelabpharmacy.com/blog/best-skincare-products-for-dry-skin-in-winter?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹356*

### [Cetaphil Moisturising Cream]()
*₹791*

### [Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra-Nourishing Cream]()
*₹629*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹265.50*

**🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
Great choice if your skin gets **very dry, tight or flaky**. It contains ceramides and hyaluronic acid and is fragrance-free; current Indian listings are around ₹350–₹1,700 depending on seller/size. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best alternative: Cetaphil Moisturising Cream**  
A particularly good straightforward option if you want a **rich, simple moisturizer** without a lot of actives.

**🥉 Best for very dry/sensitive skin: Bioderma Atoderm Crème**  
Rich and nourishing, especially useful if your skin feels uncomfortable or easily irritated in winter.

**💰 Best budget option: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser**  
Currently around ₹265 in the shopping results, making it a nice Indian-brand option if you don't want to spend much.

**If I had to choose just one:** **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** for genuinely dry winter skin.

Apply it to **slightly damp skin**, especially after washing. If your skin is extremely dry, you can use a slightly thicker layer at night.

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹300/₹500/₹1,000)** and whether your skin is **dry + acne-prone or just dry**, I can narrow it down to the best 2–3 options for you.
